title: Kusikiliza kwa Kutathmini (Theme 7: Huduma katika asasi za kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child judges a talk by its reasons, evidence and language.

floor.prerequisite: Listens to a short talk and says who and what.
floor.question: Mzungumzaji alizungumzia nini?
floor.answer: the topic or the main person

representations: the recording or a reading by the teacher
steps: Listen to the end, noting key words.
Read the question and its question word.
Find the answer in your notes.
Answer and check it fits the question.

board.say: Swali hili linataka jibu la aina gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child answers and shows where in the text or notes the answer came from.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lijibu swali lote, si jambo moja dogo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lipatane na matini, si kinyume chake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lipatikane kwenye matini, si kuongezwa kutoka nje.
Tathmini hoja na ushahidi, si mzungumzaji.

checks.question: Unatathmini mazungumzo. Ni kigezo kipi bora?
checks.answer: kama hoja zina ushahidi na mpangilio
